name: RBI Repo Rate
description: The repo rate is the rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to banks. It is the central bank's main policy lever. On 7 October 2026 the MPC raised it to 5.50% and changed its stance from neutral to calibrated tightening.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Monetary Policy Committee
releaseSchedule: Reviewed by the Monetary Policy Committee, usually every two months.
